description: Step 2 of paying on your own: call it right after hip_prepare_payment. Pay for the job with a delegated payment authorization, with no browser and no human step. payment_authorization must be a Stripe shared payment token (spt_...) granted to Have It Printed whose maximum is at least the total from hip_prepare_payment; HIP charges exactly that total and never more. NEVER send a card number, expiry, CVV or any reusable credential to this tool. If the cardholder's bank requires authentication, this returns payment_status=requires_user_action rather than bypassing it. Then use hip_get_order for printing, shipping and tracking.

job_handle.description: the job_handle that hip_create_job returned (job_ followed by 32 hex characters). Only the API key that created the job can use it.

tos_accepted.description: true only when the person paying has agreed to the Terms of Service (https://haveitprinted.com/terms.html) and content policy (https://haveitprinted.com/content-policy.html). Recorded on the order.

name: hip_complete_payment
title: Pay and send to print
